title: Vendors
lead: Your organization’s own vendors, which only it sees, and Aveline’s list, which every organization sees. Book one for an event from that event’s page.

list.title: Vendors to choose from
list.empty: No vendors yet. Add your own below.
list.emptyCategory: No vendors of this kind yet.

add.title: Add a vendor
add.lead: Only your organization sees the vendors it adds.
add.name: Name
add.notesHelp: Optional. Only those who may change your vendors see them.

status.unchanged: Nothing had changed, so nothing was sent.
status.newLink: A new link was made, and the one sent before no longer works. Copy the new one to send it.
status.ended: The booking with {{name}} was ended. Their link no longer works.
status.engaged: {{name}} is engaged again, with a new link. Copy it to send it.
status.booked: Booked. Copy the brief link below to send it to the vendor.
status.paused: The brief is paused: its link opens nothing until you let {{name}} see it again.

errors.email: Enter an email address, like name@example.com.
errors.fee: Enter the amount in digits, with no more decimals than the currency has, like 150000.
errors.refused: This was refused. Check it and try again.

forbidden.add: Your role can’t add vendors. The organization’s owner or a manager can.
forbidden.bookings: Vendors aren’t part of your role on this event. The event’s owner or a coordinator can see them.
forbidden.book: Your role can’t book vendors. The event’s owner or a coordinator can.
forbidden.change: Your role can’t change bookings. The event’s owner or a coordinator can.
forbidden.newLink: Your role can’t replace brief links. The event’s owner or a coordinator can.
forbidden.end: Your role can’t end bookings. The event’s owner or a coordinator can.
forbidden.engageAgain: Your role can’t engage a vendor again. The event’s owner or a coordinator can.
forbidden.choices: Vendors aren’t part of your role on this event. The event’s owner or a coordinator can book one.
forbidden.correct: Your role can’t correct vendors. The organization’s owner or a manager can.
forbidden.remove: Your role can’t remove vendors. The organization’s owner or a manager can.
forbidden.pause: Your role can’t pause or resume a brief. The event’s owner or a coordinator can.

refused.noOrganization: Vendors are kept by an organization, and your account isn’t a member of one: you may have been invited onto an event only. Ask the organization’s owner to book a vendor, or to add you to the organization.
refused.chooseOrganization: You belong to more than one organization, and this page can’t choose between them yet.
refused.rateLimited: Too many requests just now. Wait a moment, then try again.
refused.vendorGone: That vendor isn’t on your organization’s list or Aveline’s any more. Choose another.
refused.bookingGone: This booking is no longer on the event. The page has been reloaded.
refused.fields: Some details were refused. Check the marked fields.
refused.noAnswer: There was no answer. Check your connection, then try again.

scopes.none: Nothing ticked: the brief shares the event and its venues only.
scopes.noneShort: the event and its venues only
scopes.contactsWarning: Guests’ contact details give this vendor the email address and phone number of every guest who is coming.

headcount.label: Headcount
headcount.help: How many are coming, by side and by venue. Numbers only.

catering.label: Catering
catering.help: Covers and dietary requirements, with each guest’s note under their name.

seating.label: Seating
seating.help: Tables, their size, and who sits at each by name.

households.label: Households
households.help: The names of the guests who are coming, grouped by household.

contacts.label: Guests’ contact details
contacts.help: The email and phone of every guest who is coming.

fee.label: Agreed fee
fee.help: Optional. Digits, in the currency chosen below.
fee.clearHelp: Digits, in the currency chosen below. Empty it to remove the fee.

bookings.title: Vendors
bookings.lead: Who is booked for this event, and what each one’s brief shares with them.

booking.title: A booking
booking.scopesHelp: The vendor sees the change the next time they open their brief.
booking.missing: This booking isn’t on the event. It may have been opened from an old link.

book.title: Book a vendor
book.lead: Choose a vendor, what their brief shares, and the fee if one is agreed. Booking makes the link you send them.
book.vendorHelp: Vendors already booked are changed on their own booking’s page.
book.scopesHelp: The usual set for this kind of vendor is ticked to start with. The vendor reads exactly what is ticked.
book.none: Your organization has no vendors yet, and Aveline’s list is empty too. Add one first.
book.addFirst: Add a vendor to your organization
book.notListed: Not listed? Add a vendor to your organization

link.title: The brief link
link.lead: Send this link to the vendor. It opens their brief without an account, so treat it like a key: anyone who has it can read the brief.
link.copied: The link was copied. Paste it into your message to the vendor.
link.refused: Your browser didn’t allow copying. Try again, or use another browser.
link.unsendable: This copy of Aveline doesn’t know its public address, so the link wouldn’t open for the vendor. Nothing was copied. Tell whoever runs Aveline.
link.hidden: The link isn’t yours to see. The event’s owner or a coordinator can send it.
link.ended: The booking was ended, so its link no longer works.

newLink.title: Make a new link?
newLink.body: The link sent to {{name}} stops working at once. They’ll need the new one to read their brief.

end.title: End the booking with {{name}}?
end.body: Their brief link stops working at once. The booking is kept, with its fee, and can be engaged again.

ended.lead: This booking was ended. Engaging the vendor again makes a new link to send them.

remove.title: Remove {{name}} from your vendors?
remove.body: They are no longer offered for new bookings. Bookings already made, and the briefs sent with them, are kept.

pause.title: Who can open the brief
pause.on: {{name}} can open their brief with the link you sent.
pause.off: The brief is paused: the link you sent opens nothing for now. The booking, its fee and its sections are kept.
